record.question: Which app has been launched by Google to understand, control and save data usage?
record.explanation: Answer B: Datally. Google launched Datally on 30 November 2017 to understand, control and save mobile data. Google’s original product announcement uses exactly those functions. Historical/source note: Historical 2017 launch; not a claim that the app remains available today. Reference: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/next-billion-users/meet-datally-new-way-understand-control-and-save-mobile-data/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
